rules.reason: Both can irritate; commonly advised in different routines
rules.suggestion: Vitamin C in AM, retinoid in PM

rules.reason: Both exfoliate and can dry and irritate the skin together
rules.suggestion: AHA in AM and retinoid in PM, or use them on different nights

rules.reason: Both can dry and irritate the skin together
rules.suggestion: Salicylic acid in AM, retinoid in PM

rules.reason: Benzoyl peroxide breaks down some retinoids, such as tretinoin, when applied at the same time
rules.suggestion: Benzoyl peroxide in AM, retinoid in PM

rules.reason: Two exfoliating acids together can irritate and dry the skin
rules.suggestion: Start with one; if the skin gets red or dry, use them on different days

rules.reason: Two AHA products in one routine double the exfoliation and can irritate
rules.suggestion: Keep one AHA product in this routine

rules.reason: Both are acidic and can irritate together, especially when starting either
rules.suggestion: Vitamin C in AM, AHA in PM

rules.reason: Two retinoid products in one routine add irritation; retinoids are best started low and slow
rules.suggestion: Keep one retinoid product in this routine
